title: Nasty Juice Blood Berry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 10mg
description: Nasty Salt Blood Berry delivers an uncanny fusion of ripe Raspberries with a refreshing twist of zesty Lemonade. This e-liquid captures the perfect balance between the sweetness of juicy raspberries and the tangy bite of lemonade, resulting in a flavourful and refreshing vape experience that’s ideal for fans of fresh summer beverages. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Nasty Salt Nicotine Salt e-liquids are perfect for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg nicotine strength, these e-liquids provide a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine delivery, making them an excellent choice for adult smokers and vapers looking for a quick and satisfying nicotine fix. Made in Malaysia, Nasty Juice is known for its premium quality and innovative flavour profiles, and the Nasty Salt range brings these popular flavours into the world of nicotine salts. Discover why Nasty Juice is a favourite among vapers worldwide with their bold and delicious e-liquid offerings.
